usual_baseline: Freehand clerking misses much. Vital signs 25–46%, medications 20–48%, VTE plan 14–32%, social history 36–40%. Only 4% of surgical proformas fully completed at Ipswich. Psychiatry clerkings are similar: aggregate compliance 50.6%, risk management plan 8.6%.
fix_that_works: A specialty proforma. ENT referral source 28% to 97%, VTE 14% to 78% [2025]. Galway items rose to 94–100% [1625]. Paediatric booklets gave 33% absolute gain, medications 48% to 99% [1567]. Complete clerking 36% to 88% [1226]. Psychiatry risk assessment 18% to 59% [3335]. A doctor's assistant raised consultant review within 14 h from 47% to 97% [2672].
fix_that_fails: Induction lecture alone: NEWS 46% to 54%, advice to patients 0% to 16% [2472]. Proformas leave gaps: vital signs stuck at 52–70% [1567][1625], investigation results 30% to 35% [1665]. Moving online cut 'time recorded' 18% to 0% [1209]. Full proforma completion only 4% to 26% [2277].
consultant_advice: Heavily overdone, with the same finding and fix every time. Don't repeat it if a proforma exists. Audit whether the proforma is actually used, or the items proformas still miss: observations, investigation results and risk management plans.
